faction.name: The Ascendancy
faction.blurb: Sleek, ruthless, obedient. The lance-cruiser Sixth Verdict and her Blade escort. Spend Ordinals to hit harder: they are grown to be spent.
faction.openingJournal: The broadcast reached everyone at once. The Sixth Verdict makes for the Ion Reef gate.
faction.bossHail:
"Sixth Verdict. I know that hull. You took my eye at Kessane and logged it as efficiency."

"The Long Promise holds this gate. Behind me are eleven worlds that will never hear your Prime's name. Come and be counted."
faction.bossHailEnraged: "And I have read the convoy's last message. All of it."
faction.winAhead: The Long Promise burns behind you and the gate stands open. No other fleet has passed it. The Prime will be informed that the Sixth Verdict leads the race to the Silence.
faction.winBehind: The Long Promise burns behind you, but the Concord's main fleet went through the gate while Venn held you here. You are through the Ion Reef, and you are second.
faction.winThirdAhead: Something else came through first, though. The gate's sensors logged it as weather.
faction.outpaced: Venn did not need to win. He needed to hold the gate until everyone else had gone through it, and he has. The Sixth Verdict is recalled to Lumen to explain the delay in person.
faction.lostAhead: The last signal from the Sixth Verdict is logged, numbered and filed. The Concord reaches the gate unopposed.
faction.lostBehind: The last signal from the Sixth Verdict is logged, numbered and filed. Another hull is already being fitted with her name.
faction.briefing:
Nine days ago every receiver in the Ascendancy heard the same thing at the same moment: four seconds of nothing. Not static. Nothing, shaped like a voice. The Waymind choirs traced it to a point past the Ion Reef and then would not say what was there.

The Prime has decreed that the Ascendancy will reach the Silence first. The Concord heard it too and has voted to go. Something else is moving that way that does not vote and was not decreed.

You command the Sixth Verdict. The gate at the far side of the Reef is held by Marshal Oru Venn. Lumen expects a report.
faction.rivalPasses: The Concord fleet has passed you in the Reef. Lumen has been informed, and has asked for a reason.
faction.thirdPasses: Something overtook the fleet in the dark. Sensors logged it as weather. Four Ordinals on the night watch have been reassigned for describing a sound.

laterSectors.name: Sector II - The Kessane Drift
laterSectors.bossHail:
"Sixth Verdict. You killed Oru Venn at the Reef. He was my friend, and he was the last of us who thought you could be reasoned with."

"This is the Common Cause, with every hull the Council could find. Kessane is behind me. You will not harvest it twice."
laterSectors.bossHailEnraged: "The convoy's dead have been read into the record. All of them. I had the names piped to my gun crews."
laterSectors.arrival:
Beyond the gate is the Kessane Drift: the world the Ascendancy and the Concord broke eleven years ago, and the hulls of both fleets still turning around it. The broadcast is louder here. The Waymind has started answering it in its sleep.

The Concord's last fleet is ahead of you, and it knows what you did at the Reef. The ships out here are better found and better led.
laterSectors.winAhead: Dray's flagship is a new wreck among the old ones, and the Kessane gate stands open. Beyond it there is nothing on any chart, and the broadcast is very close now. The Prime will be informed that the Sixth Verdict goes on alone.
laterSectors.winBehind: Dray's flagship is a new wreck among the old ones, but the Concord's last ships slipped through the gate while she held you. You are through the Drift, and something is ahead of you.
laterSectors.outpaced: Dray never meant to win. She meant to stand in the door until everyone she loved was through it, and she did. The Sixth Verdict is recalled to Lumen. The Waymind does not want to go.

modules.name: Spinal Lance
modules.text: One long gun the whole ship is built around. Two Lance Volleys.

modules.name: Lance Battery
modules.text: Three short lances in place of the spinal mount: cheaper shots, shorter reach.

modules.name: Macro Batteries
modules.text: Turret sponsons on both flanks. Two Broadside Batteries.

modules.name: Beam Galleries
modules.text: A raking beam that hits everything abeam, and runs hot. Heat cap -1.

modules.name: Flak Arrays
modules.text: Point defence domes: kills craft and torpedoes alongside. Shields +1.

modules.name: Radiator Stack
modules.text: Fins that dump reactor heat. Heat cap +2, Vent Plasma.

modules.name: Command Spire
modules.text: The Prime's voice aboard. Precision Edict and a Decimation Order.

modules.name: Waymind Crown
modules.text: A second Waymind grown for targeting. Waymind Targeting and Scry the Void.

modules.name: Boarding Pods
modules.text: Ordinals as ammunition. Boarding Action and Purge Their Decks.

modules.name: Armored Plating
modules.text: Layered ceramic over the drive. Hull +8, max Speed -1, Hold the Line.

edicts.name: The Tithe of Blood
edicts.decree: The vats are full. See that they are emptied to some purpose.
edicts.text: Expend 10 Ordinals in battle before you reach the gate.

edicts.name: No Quarter
edicts.decree: A fleet that breaks contact has confessed. Finish what you begin.
edicts.text: End no battle in a stand-off before the gate.

edicts.name: The Named Shall Be Unnamed
edicts.decree: One of theirs has been permitted a reputation. Correct this.
edicts.text: Destroy the commander who hunts you before you reach the gate.

edicts.name: First Through the Gate
edicts.decree: The Prime is not to learn of the gate from anyone else.
edicts.text: Reach the gate ahead of the Concord.

edicts.name: An Audit of Stores
edicts.decree: Dockyards are for the wounded and the idle. You are neither.
edicts.text: Buy no more than 2 shipyard services before the gate. Darts and false beacons are not counted.

edicts.name: Cull the Strong
edicts.decree: Their best ships are known to us by name. Bring fewer names back.
edicts.text: Win an elite battle before you reach the gate.

edicts.name: Nothing Wasted
edicts.decree: A hull lost without instruction is a theft from the Prime.
edicts.text: Do not lose your escort in battle before the gate.
